I'm looking at a text about phenylketonuria genetics, describing how loss of a BamHI restriction site in exon 7 of the PAH gene revealed two distinct point mutations at codon 272, and I need to annotate this passage.

I'm continuing to identify disease entities in the passage: "phenylketonuria" as a SpecificDisease, "Classical phenylketonuria" also as SpecificDisease since it refers to a particular disease form, and I'm now evaluating whether "autosomal recessive disease" qualifies as a DiseaseClass per the annotation guidelines.

I note that "PKU" later in the text is the same disease referenced by abbreviation, so it should be annotated separately as its own SpecificDisease mention. I'm now puzzling over "PAH deficiencies" -- while "deficiency" alone is usually too general to annotate, "PAH deficiency" specifically denotes the biochemical cause of phenylketonuria and its variants, so I'm weighing whether it counts as a disease mention here.

Looking at the actual sentence context, "mutant genotypes associated with PAH deficiencies" seems to treat PAH deficiencies as a family of disorders encompassing classical PKU, mild PKU, and mild hyperphenylalaninemia—so DiseaseClass fits better here than Specific Disease. I'll also note that "PAH" alone, when used as the gene/protein abbreviation, isn't a disease mention, and "phenylalanine hydroxylase" and "mutations" aren't diseases either, so I'm moving on to check "RFLP haplotype 7 alleles" next.

"Deficiency of hepatic phenylalanine hydroxylase" is descriptive, not a disease name itself, so I won't annotate it, though "autosomal recessive disease" still counts as a DiseaseClass mention, and the title's "phenylketonuria" is a SpecificDisease. I need to remember that every disease mention gets marked, even duplicates within the same sentence, so I should go through and catalog each occurrence systematically.

Going sentence by sentence: the title gives "phenylketonuria" as SpecificDisease; sentence two gives "Classical phenylketonuria" as SpecificDisease and "autosomal recessive disease" as DiseaseClass; the mutation-description sentences have no disease mentions; and the final sentence mentions "PKU" as SpecificDisease along with "PAH deficiencies," which I need to decide between DiseaseClass and SpecificDisease.

For "PAH deficiencies," the plural form and context — "the large variety of mutant genotypes associated with PAH deficiencies" — suggests it's referring to the broader family of conditions caused by PAH enzyme deficiency (classical PKU, mild PKU, mild hyperphenylalaninemia), so I'll classify it as DiseaseClass rather than a specific named disease.
